title: Lernstudio learning packet v1
description: One explicit, data-only learning note. LOCAL_DRAFT_ONLY never authorizes publication or execution.
$comment: Transport: UTF-8 JSON, at most 131072 bytes including whitespace. LernPackets is the runtime validator: it additionally checks Unicode scalar validity, real calendar dates, HTTPS parsing, and optional knownIds membership. JSON Schema cannot bind a current lesson catalogue. Text remains literal text, including markup. No URL is fetched. Lengths count Unicode code points. Secrets, private paths, raw logs, files and operational instructions must not be placed in free text.

anyOf.description: Absolute HTTPS reference. LernPackets additionally validates this string with the WHATWG URL parser and rejects malformed percent escapes. Unicode spelling is preserved as data.

lessonId.$comment: Requires Unicode-aware ECMAScript regular expressions (u flag). First character: Unicode letter or number. Following characters may also be combining marks, underscore or ASCII hyphen. Exact code points are preserved; no normalization. Runtime knownIds membership binds the current curriculum. packet.id remains ASCII.
